items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 61:1
items.html: (To the question) The first is the ascent of the screen that was refined to AVI. The second is its inclusion in the coupling of Achor be Achor [back to back] of AVI. The third is the inclusion in the coupling of Panim be Achor [face to back] of AVI. The fourth is the inclusion in the coupling of Panim be Panim [face to face] of AVI. (p. 564, Item 7)
